integrity: The proof uses only the explicit branch map. It does not rely on Persson's main absolute-continuity theorem, whose proof was later reported incomplete in the corrigendum.
scientific_limitations: Applies to invariant Borel probabilities for the Belykh map with zero mass on its excluded discontinuity. It proves moment and equality-rigidity laws only; it does not assert existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, absolute continuity, or mixing. The lower boundary is attainable only under the explicit branch-admissibility condition stated in RESULT.md.
title: Branch-balance variance corridor and extremal rigidity in the Belykh map
